You play Sokoban in a room of 6 x 6 cells (columns A to F from the left, rows 1 to 6 from the top). Push the box onto the target square. The target is hidden: it is one of the cells the box can be pushed to, each equally likely, and it shows only when you stand on it or right next to it (not diagonally). UP, DOWN, LEFT and RIGHT move you one cell; a step into the box pushes it, if the cell behind it is free. You have 15 actions, one each turn.
